name: Demon Wife à la carte
source:
You're enjoying a quiet night running to your local convenience store when you run into a demon outside. She asks you to grab her some snacks because the cashier doesn't accept demon blood oaths. And when you do return with said offering, the demon marries you on the spot!

[From [url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/demon-wife]Itchio[/url]]
translation:
某个宁静的夜晚，你正悠闲地散步去附近的便利店，却在店门外撞见了一名恶魔少女。因为收银员拒收恶魔的血之誓约，她便拜托你帮她买点零食。而当你带着这笔“祭品”回到她面前时，这位恶魔居然当场向你求婚、要嫁给你为妻！

[摘自[url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/demon-wife]itch.io[/url]]
